blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Forward-process reinforcement learning adapts diffusion and flow-matching models by re-noising rewarded generations into regression targets. Because negative advantages induce concave updates with unbounded repulsive gradients, existing methods stabilize training using cached predictions from a moving policy copy, yet these anchors also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling: after separating frozen-reference regularizers, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these roles. Positive samples retain standard target fitting, whose self-limiting update vanishes at the observed target independently of the moving anchor. Negative samples instead use the first-order tangent of the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction, preserving the local repulsion direction with a prediction-independent gradient. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these requirements uniquely determine the parameter-free gate $ω(a)=\max(-a,0)$. Because the moving copy provides local linearization rather than retention, AGA assigns long-horizon behavior preservation to a frozen pretrained reference regularized at its operating classifier-free guidance scale, interpreted through an implicit-reward lens. Across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, our experiments show that displacing positive targets degrades visual quality and heightens sensitivity to policy-copy schedules, whereas AGA consistently improves the reward--quality trade-off.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion and flow-matching models learn generative dynamics through velocity or noise prediction objectives [ 11 , 19 ] , powering modern latent text-to-image synthesis [ 26 , 6 ] . Online reinforcement learning (RL) adapts these models to downstream goals such as compositional object placement, legible text rendering, and human preference alignment using scalar rewards evaluated on model-generated samples [ 2 , 7 , 21 ] . Rather than backpropagating through multi-step sampling chains or estimating trajectory-level likelihood ratios, forward-process RL brings reward feedback directly into the pretraining interface: sample an image, evaluate its reward, re-noise it along the forward path, and update a velocity-matching objective at independent noised states [ 33 , 37 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 扩散和流比模型通过速度或噪声预测目标[11,19]学习基因动力学[26,6],为现代潜在文本到图像合成提供动力[26,6]. 在线强化学习(RL)使这些模型适应下游的目标,例如组成对象的放置,可辨识的文本渲染,以及利用模型生成的样本上评价的scalar奖励来进行人类偏好调整[2,7,21]. 与其通过多步采样链或估计轨迹级概率比率进行回传,前置过程RL直接将奖励反馈带入预训界面:对图像进行取样,评价其奖励,沿前置路径重新发出信号,在独立噪声状态更新速度匹配目标[33,37,1].

blocks.en: Positive and negative advantages play fundamentally asymmetric roles in this local regression problem. A positive-advantage sample supplies a concrete velocity target to fit, whereas a negative-advantage sample indicates an undesirable generation to move away from. Direct signed matching applies a weighted squared error to both branches, but flipping the sign makes the negative branch concave: its repulsive gradient grows linearly with prediction error, driving self-amplifying runaway updates as the policy moves away from the penalized target. Recent methods therefore incorporate cached predictions from a moving policy copy as quadratic penalties or target corrections to restore local stability [ 33 , 37 , 16 , 8 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 积极和消极的优势在这个局部回归问题上起着根本的不对称作用。 阳性优势样本提供适合的混凝土速度目标,而阴性优势样本则表明不可取的一代人要离开。 直接签名匹配对两个分支都应用加权平方误差,但翻转标志使负分支凸起:其反感梯度随着预测误差而呈线性增长,随着政策远离被处罚目标而驱动自我模拟运行更新. 因此,最近的方法将移动的政策副本中的缓存预测作为四重处罚或目标矫正,以恢复当地稳定[33、37、16、8、1]。

blocks.en: Yet stabilizing negative updates with a moving anchor can also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. Separating frozen-reference regularizers, we show that widely used forward-process objectives share a unified local quadratic form whose anchor weight is affine in the signed advantage. Within this family, removing negative curvature inevitably shifts the stationary target of positive samples: stabilizing the negative branch pulls positive targets toward the moving prediction, rescales them by advantage magnitude, or eliminates a unique stationary target altogether. We call this conflict anchor coupling . The key design question is therefore how to stabilize negative repulsion without shifting the regression targets supplied by positive feedback .
blocks.zh: 然而,用移动的锚稳定负面的更新也可以改变积极的反馈如何教导模型适合。 分离冷冻参照常态器,我们显示,广泛使用的前置过程目标共享一个统一的局部四极形式,其锚重在签名的优势中是相当的. 在这个家族中,去除负曲率将不可避免地转移正样本的固定目标:稳定负分支将正目标拉向移动的预测,按照优势大小调整,或者完全消灭一个独特的固定目标. 我们称这场冲突为联合 因此,关键的设计问题是如何稳定消极的反弹,而不改变由积极反馈提供的回归目标。

blocks.en: We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these two roles. On positive samples, AGA retains standard target regression: advantage scales fitting strength while updates follow the live prediction residual, remaining self-limiting and vanishing at the observed target regardless of the moving anchor. On negative samples, AGA replaces the concave quadratic with its first-order tangent upper bound expanded at the moving-policy prediction, preserving the local repulsion direction while keeping the prediction-space gradient independent of the online prediction. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these two criteria uniquely determine the parameter-free gate ω ⁡ ( a ) = max ⁡ ( − a , 0 ) \omega(a)=\max(-a,0) , under which the moving copy sets the negative expansion point without displacing positive targets.
blocks.zh: 我们建议“优异的适应”将这两个角色脱钩。 在阳性样本上,AGA保留了标准的目标回归:优势尺度适配强度,同时更新跟随活性预测残基,剩余自限和消失在观测目标上,而不论移动锚. 在阴性样本上,AGA用其在移动政策预测时扩展的第一阶正切线上界取代凸缘四极体,保持局部反向,同时保持预测-空间梯度独立于在线预测. 在四进制-anchor家族内部,这两个标准独占地决定了参数无门QQQ(a)=最大QQ(−,0)\omega(a)=\max(-a,0),根据这个标准,移动拷贝设定了负扩展点而不会取代正目标.

blocks.en: Because this gated moving anchor provides zero-curvature linearization rather than quadratic retention, it does not constrain long-horizon policy drift. AGA therefore assigns global behavior preservation to a separate frozen pretrained reference. Recent forward-process RL methods often adopt CFG-free ( γ = 1 \gamma=1 ) training for efficiency, with DiffusionNFT interpreting RL as internalizing guidance without explicit CFG [ 33 , 37 ] . Yet classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 10 ] still governs the effective sampling distribution of the pretrained model even with fixed weights, so γ = 1 \gamma=1 regularizes toward a weak unguided prior rather than the model’s preferred guided behavior. We therefore regularize the composed guided velocity field at the operating guidance scale used for rollout and evaluation, and ground this reference choice in an endpoint implicit-reward view.
blocks.zh: 由于这个有门的移动锚提供了零曲线线性化而非四面体保留,因此它不会限制长视政策漂移. 因此,AGA将全球行为保全指定为单独冻结的预先训练过的参考文献. 最近的前置流程RL方法往往采用无CFG(γ = 1\gamma=1)的高效训练,DifmusionNFT将RL解释为内部化指导,而没有明确的CFG[33,37]. 然而无分类指导(CFG)[10]仍然制约着预先训练过的模型的有效采样分布,即使有固定的重量,所以γ = 1\gamma=1 规范了一种弱无指导的前导而非模型偏爱的引导行为。 因此,我们按用于推出和评价的操作指导尺度,使构成的制导速度场正规化,并将这一参考选择置于一个隐含奖励的终点。

blocks.en: Experiments on SD3.5-Medium across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show improved task adaptation and reward–quality trade-offs, including gains under matched CFG-free ( γ = 1 \gamma=1 ) training. Our contributions are: • We formalize anchor coupling , proving that affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. • We derive AGA’s gate ω ⁡ ( a ) = max ⁡ ( − a , 0 ) \omega(a)=\max(-a,0) from positive target preservation and negative tangent linearization, and pair it with guided frozen-reference retention to separate local feedback from behavior preservation. • Through controlled studies of feedback branches, policy-copy updates, and guidance scales, we show that preserving positive targets prevents quality collapse and sustains a superior reward–quality balance.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Trajectory-based RL methods such as DDPO and DPOK optimize online rewards through multi-step denoising policies [ 2 , 7 , 29 ] , a paradigm extended to flow and diffusion generators by Flow-GRPO and DanceGRPO [ 21 , 34 ] . Alternative approaches backpropagate differentiable rewards through sampling trajectories [ 4 ] or align models offline from pairwise and temporal preferences [ 31 , 35 ] . Because aggressive reward maximization frequently degrades visual realism and diversity through reward over-optimization, recent work tracks general image quality on held-out prompts alongside task rewards [ 14 , 18 ] . Focusing on online forward-process RL, we study how anchor design in this velocity-matching interface governs the trade-off between task reward and held-out image quality.
blocks.zh: 基于轨迹的RL方法,如DDPO和DPOK,通过多步调试政策[2,7,29]优化在线奖励,这个范式被Flow-GRPO和DanceGRPO[21,34]推广到流动和传播生成器. 通过采样轨迹[4]或使模型脱离对偶偏好和时间偏好[31,35] ,替代方法反向提供不同的奖励。 由于积极奖励的最大化经常通过奖励的过度优化而降低视觉现实主义和多样性,最近的工作跟踪了被搁置的提示上的一般图像质量,同时跟踪任务奖励[14,18]. 专注于在线前置进程 RL,我们研究这个速度匹配接口中的锚定设计如何支配任务奖励和被搁置图像质量之间的权衡.

blocks.en: Forward-process RL methods differ in how they incorporate cached moving-policy predictions to stabilize negative-advantage updates. AWM combines advantage-weighted matching with an EMA velocity penalty [ 33 ] , while AdvantageFlow sets promptwise anchor weights to enforce local strong convexity and reduce gradient variance [ 16 ] . DiffusionNFT constructs implicit positive and negative velocity predictions to form a convex regression loss [ 37 ] , FlowAWR regresses toward shifted targets derived from a reward-tilted velocity field [ 8 ] , and RAM obtains reward-corrected targets from optimal control [ 1 ] , with RVM providing a unified velocity-matching parameterization [ 3 ] . Unlike affine anchor rules across this family, which couple negative-curvature stabilization to positive-target shifts, AGA decouples the two feedback signs.
blocks.zh: 前进进程RL方法在如何纳入缓存的移动政策预测以稳定负优势更新方面有所不同. AWM将优势加权比对与EMA速度罚[33],而优势则结合. 流程设置了即时锚重,以强制实施局部强对流并降低梯度差异[16]. 扩散 NFT构造了隐含的正负速度预测,形成对流回归损失[37],Flow AWR退向从悬赏速度场[8]得到的变换目标,RAM从最佳控制[1]获得悬赏修正目标,RVM提供统一的速度匹配参数[3]. AGA与整个家族的类似锚定规则不同,后者将负曲线稳定到正目标转变,AGA将两个反馈信号脱钩.

blocks.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) trades diversity for fidelity by extrapolating conditional and unconditional predictions [ 5 , 10 ] . Diff-Instruct++ connects CFG distillation to implicit rewards [ 22 ] , while Decoupled DMD and Reinforcement Learning Guidance study guidance in distribution matching and alignment [ 20 , 13 ] . While recent forward-process RL methods use CFG-free ( γ = 1 \gamma=1 ) training for efficiency [ 33 , 37 ] , frozen references preserve pretrained capabilities during RL [ 7 , 16 ] , including guided reference matching in CRD and RVM [ 38 , 3 ] . Building on these guided regularizers, we study when CFG-free anchoring degrades visual quality, ground reference-scale selection in an implicit-reward criterion, and regularize the composed guided field throughout adaptation.
blocks.zh: 无分类制导(CFG)通过推断有条件和无条件的预测,将多样性用于忠诚[5,10]. Diff-Instruct++将CFG蒸馏与隐含的奖赏[22]连接起来,而DMD和强化学习指导在发行匹配和对齐方面的研究指导[20,13]. 虽然最近的前置流程RL方法使用无CFG(γ = 1\gamma=1)效率训练[33,37],但冻结的参考文献在RL[7,16]期间保留了预先训练的能力,包括在CRD和RVM[38,3]中的指导参考文献匹配. 在这些导引常态器的基础上,我们研究CFG无锚定时会降低视觉质量,在隐含的奖励标准中选择地面参照尺度,在整个适应过程中规范所构成的导引场.

blocks.zh: 3. 有利的适应

blocks.en: We first analyze how moving-policy anchors couple negative-update stabilization to positive target placement (Section 3.1 ). We then derive an advantage-gated objective that decouples these roles (Section 3.2 ) and pair it with guided frozen-reference retention (Section 3.3 ). Section 3.4 summarizes the complete training procedure.

blocks.en: We evaluate compositional generation on GenEval [ 9 ] (testing object counting, spatial relations, and attribute binding), visual text rendering on the OCR benchmark from Flow-GRPO [ 21 ] (measuring character-level rendering accuracy), and human preference alignment on PickScore [ 15 ] . Because optimizing a task reward can degrade visual realism or prompt fidelity outside the training distribution [ 14 , 18 ] , we also evaluate all adapted models on held-out DrawBench prompts [ 27 ] using four complementary metrics: ImageReward [ 32 ] and PickScore [ 15 ] for human preference, Aesthetic Score [ 28 ] for visual appeal, and CLIP similarity [ 25 ] for text-image alignment.

blocks.en: Leaving negative samples unanchored ( ω = 0 \omega=0 ) or omitting negative feedback ( Positive-only ) both collapse training (Table 4.2 ; ω = 0 \omega=0 in Figure 2 ), confirming both halves of Sections 3.1 – 3.2 . Under ω = 0 \omega=0 , concave negative curvature makes repulsion grow with ‖ v − u ‖ \|v-u\| , causing self-amplifying divergence. Conversely, dropping negative feedback eliminates repulsion against poor rollouts, so positive-only self-fitting reinforces failing rollout modes and collapses. Stable adaptation thus requires keeping negative repulsion while removing its curvature via tangent linearization at v a v_{\rm a} .
blocks.zh: 将阴性样本留作无序(QQ = 0\omega = 0)或省略负反馈(只有阳性)两种崩溃训练(表4.2;QQ = 0\omega = 0在图2中),证实两者都是3.1–3.2节的一半. 在QQ = 0\omega = 0下,凸起负曲率使反推力随着QQ v – u → \|v-u – 导致自我放大差异. 反之,负面反馈的减少消除了对低劣推出的反感,因此只有正面的自我适应强化了失败推出模式和崩溃. 因此,稳定的适应要求保持负反推力,同时在v_{\rm a}时通过直线化去除曲率。

blocks.en: Holding AGA’s negative tangent branch fixed, we first replace positive fitting with the all-sign tangent rule ω = − a \omega=-a (RAM’s moving-anchor component). blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Moving-policy anchors introduced to stabilize negative feedback in forward-process RL can inadvertently alter what positive feedback teaches a diffusion model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling , proving that within the local quadratic family, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) resolves this coupling by retaining self-limiting target regression on positive samples and linearizing the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction on negative samples. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these requirements uniquely determine the parameter-free gate ω ⁡ ( a ) = max ⁡ ( − a , 0 ) \omega(a)=\max(-a,0) . Complementing local feedback with a frozen pretrained reference regularized at its operating guidance scale separates step-level stabilization from long-horizon behavior retention. Across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, our results show that displacing positive targets degrades visual fidelity and heightens sensitivity to policy-copy schedules, establishing positive target preservation alongside negative-curvature control as a core principle for diffusion RL.
blocks.zh: 为稳定前置进程RL中的负面反馈而引入的移动政策锚点,会无意中改变积极的反馈所教导的传播模式的适合性. 我们将这场冲突正式化为主线组合, 证明在当地四重力家族中, 优势-Gated adaption(AGA)通过在正样品上保留自限目标回归,并在负样品的移动政策预测中将集合目标线性化,解决了这种耦合. 在四极管家族中,这些要求独占地决定了无参数门QQ(a) = 最大QQ(-,0)\omega(a) max(-a,0) 。 作为当地反馈的补充,在操作指导尺度上对已冻结的预先培训的参考标准进行规范化,将步态稳定与长期行为保留区分开来。 在整个组成、文本渲染和偏好调整过程中,我们的结果表明,取代正目标会降低视觉的忠诚度,并提高对政策复制时间表的敏感性,将正目标保存与负曲线控制一起作为传播RL的核心原则。
